params.message:
Contacts hold all support: givers become contacts, and support from elsewhere is entered by hand

The column Supports only knew gifts through the website, matched on the address of a
contact. A company that sponsors by bank transfer, a foundation with a grant or a gift in
kind showed as not supporting yet, and people who gave online without being a contact were
only counted.

- Whoever gives through the website becomes a contact when the payment comes in, without a
  newsletter, since they did not ask for one. Those who gave before can be added in one go
  from the line that counts them. Someone already a contact, also someone who unsubscribed,
  stays as they are.
- Per contact, support can be entered by hand: a bank transfer, a sponsorship, a grant, a
  gift in kind or other, with amount, date and a note, and who entered it. Clicking the
  amount of a contact opens what they gave online and by hand, where entries are added and
  removed. It is kept on the contact, which is private like the rest of the list; the
  donations and their certificates are not touched.
- The column shows the total and what of it came in this year. The page adds online and by
  hand up itself, so a change by hand shows at once without asking Mollie again.
- All of this, and that a contact came in through a gift, is only for people who may also
  open the donations.
